title: Sharp Blinding light alarm clock!
text: Sharp Blinding light alarm clock!. I DO like this clock because it's easy to set etc etc. BUT the "BLINDING light is way too much. I shoul'dve listened to the reviews! It REALLY is way too bright! I wake up here and there during the night to this clock and I tell you it's blinding! And BTW.....I have a piece of wax paper secured over this light to try and make it softer. It did make the light a tiny bit more bearable but if I find another clock similar with no blinding light I am going to replace this with my new one.
